catalog.description: Play an immersive full-screen Rainbow Conway's Game of Life on ESP-Claw / Mosaico displays. Adapted for QSPI AMOLED using paced full-frame present. Tap to seed, drag to paint or erase, long-press to reset. Shake-to-scatter needs the Lua imu module; on current Mosaico firmware imu is unavailable so shake is temporarily disabled. Conway B3/S23, chrome-less full-screen; LCD touch preferred.
catalog.author: superjames

description_i18n.zh-cn: 全屏彩虹生命游戏，采用 Conway B3/S23 规则。点击播种，拖动绘制或擦除，长按重置。适配 QSPI AMOLED 的整帧刷新；摇动打散需要 Lua IMU 模块，当前不提供该模块的 Mosaico 固件暂不支持。优先使用触摸屏。
